surfaces.purpose: Validate release-facing docs, skill counts, and documentation links.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Remote CI job runs on every push and PR.
surfaces.full_behavior: Local release gate also runs the doc-release validator.

surfaces.purpose: Run broad repository smoke checks for skills, placeholders, and runtime bundles.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Remote CI job runs on every push and PR.
surfaces.full_behavior: Local release gate runs smoke tests in the medium-weight phase.

surfaces.purpose: Validate hook safety, manifest registrations, timeouts, and shell guardrails.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs this when hook files change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run the full hook preflight.

surfaces.purpose: Ensure standards-injector language branches have matching reference files.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs this when hook/standards files change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and local release validation run the completeness check.

surfaces.purpose: Keep hook documentation aligned with runtime manifests.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs this for hook/doc changes.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run this parity check.

surfaces.purpose: Keep validate.yml summary policy, AGENTS, and blocking policy in sync.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs this for CI policy files.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run this parity check.

surfaces.purpose: Validate Codex runtime guidance, artifacts, override coverage, and lifecycle guards.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs Codex checks when skill/runtime files change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and local release validation run the Codex runtime stack.

surfaces.purpose: Verify embedded CLI assets match hook, lib, and skill sources.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode checks embedded sync when hooks or skills change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and Go build validation enforce embedded sync.

surfaces.purpose: Ensure generated CLI docs match ao help output.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode checks CLI docs when command surfaces change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run CLI docs parity.

surfaces.purpose: Run public eval canaries and baseline comparisons.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode can run eval canaries as advisory when requested.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI keeps this visible but excludes it from the summary failset.

surfaces.purpose: Run ShellCheck against shell scripts.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode checks changed shell scripts.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run the shell lint surface.

surfaces.purpose: Run markdown style checks for documentation files.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs docs checks when docs change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run markdown linting.

surfaces.purpose: Block hardcoded secrets and dangerous patterns.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs pattern scans for changed shell and config files.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run blocking security pattern scans.

surfaces.purpose: Run optional external security scanners when toolchain is available.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Skipped by local fast mode unless strict security validation is requested.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI keeps this visible but excludes it from the summary failset.

surfaces.purpose: Validate skill references, xrefs, scripts, and required links.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs this when skill files change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run strict skill integrity.

surfaces.purpose: Validate skill frontmatter against the schema.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs this when skill files change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and local release validation run skill schema checks.

surfaces.purpose: Ensure declared skill dependencies resolve.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs this when skill files change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI runs dependency checks for the full skill catalog.

surfaces.purpose: Validate contract catalog links and schemas.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs this for docs/contracts or schema changes.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run contract compatibility.

surfaces.purpose: Validate memory reinforcement feedback loop wiring.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Local fast mode skips health checks unless relevant files changed.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run MemRL health checks.

surfaces.purpose: Validate plugin manifests and reject symlinks.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs manifest validation when plugin surfaces change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and local release validation run plugin structure checks.

surfaces.purpose: Report offline retrieval precision for the local knowledge flywheel.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode treats retrieval ratchet warnings as non-blocking.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI keeps this visible but excludes it from the summary failset while the baseline ratchets.

surfaces.purpose: Build ao, run Go tests with race detection, coverage, embedded sync, and complexity checks.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs Go validation when cli files change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run the full Go validation path.

surfaces.purpose: Run native Windows installer and runtime smoke checks.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Local fast mode skips Windows-only checks unless run explicitly.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI runs Windows smoke on windows-latest.

surfaces.purpose: Run CLI command matrix, hook lifecycle, and release smoke integration checks.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Local fast mode runs targeted CLI checks when CLI files change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run CLI integration smoke tests.

surfaces.purpose: Validate JSON flag behavior across CLI commands.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Local fast mode runs this when CLI command surfaces change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI runs this after go-build completes.

surfaces.purpose: Validate file manifest overlap detection.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs swarm checks when swarm artifacts change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI self-tests file manifest overlap detection.

surfaces.purpose: Run ao doctor so stale references and missing commands remain visible.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Local fast mode skips doctor health unless full validation is requested.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI keeps this visible but excludes it from the summary failset.

surfaces.purpose: Run skill linting, line-limit, and hygiene checks.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs skill lint surfaces when skills change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI and ci-local-release run the full skill lint suite.

surfaces.purpose: Validate learning file quality and frontmatter coherence.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs learning checks when learning files change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI blocks incoherent learning artifacts.

surfaces.purpose: Run BATS integration tests for shell scripts and hooks.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs hook/script tests when relevant files change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI runs hooks and scripts BATS suites.

surfaces.purpose: Detect stale or abandoned tests.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Local fast mode skips this advisory surface by default.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI keeps this visible but excludes it from the summary failset.

surfaces.purpose: Validate swarm evidence files and file manifests.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Pre-push fast mode runs this when swarm artifacts change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Remote CI validates swarm evidence shape when present.

surfaces.purpose: Run changed-file-scoped pre-push checks before publishing a branch.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Runs only checks relevant to the selected diff scope.
surfaces.full_behavior: Use scripts/pre-push-gate.sh without --fast for broader local coverage.

surfaces.purpose: Run release-grade local CI without heavy race, security, SBOM, and hook integration checks.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Skips heavy checks and still runs core release proof.
surfaces.full_behavior: Use scripts/ci-local-release.sh for full local release validation.

surfaces.purpose: Validate this inventory against validate.yml summary needs and failset.
surfaces.fast_behavior: Runs when CI policy or inventory files change.
surfaces.full_behavior: Runs in ci-local-release phase 2.
